title: Verified rows annihilate the test vector
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $A,B,C'$ be $n\times n$ matrices over $\mathbb{F}_2$, and let $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. If $C'x=A(Bx)$ in every coordinate, then for each row index $i$, the dot product of row $i$ of $C'-AB$ with $x$ is zero in $\mathbb{F}_2$.
